This program prepares technical professionals—and those aspiring to a computer technology career—to implement smart information system solutions in the 21st century business environment.

The curriculum deepens knowledge of the procedures, tools and standards used in systems engineering and integration. Students learn object-oriented design and methodology, as well as the design and implementation of databases, telecommunications and computer networks. They also explore current trends and issues, gaining valuable insights into Information Technology 's role in day-to-day business operations.

Grounded in a thorough understanding of the management aspects of Information Technology engineering, graduates leave Hood ready to tackle complex Information Technology based challenges in business, industry, government, education, medicine and other fields. Along the way toward the master’s degree, many also obtain a certificate in Cybersecurity, the first step toward a career as an information security specialist or manager.
courses.5wg4:
Information is the lifeblood of 21st century business, industry and government. This program addresses the growing global demand for managers who can provide Information Technology solutions that facilitate achievement of organizations’ strategic goals.

The Management Information Systems program is comprehensive in scope and interdisciplinary in format. Students acquire a thorough foundation in management functions — organizational behavior, human resources, finance, production, operations — as well as in information systems, technical project teams, systems engineering, telecommunications and networks. This blended, applied approach primes master’s degree candidates to direct technology projects, both large and small, in real-world business settings.

The Management Information Systems prepares students to assess corporate Information Technology needs and evaluate options for systems solutions. They learn how to perform cost-benefit analyses, determine operational impact and lead successful systems deployment. Courses are taught by faculty with a broad range of information specializations — from security to database systems required for “large data” applications to website programming — and by adjunct instructors who have experience with corporations such as CACI International Inc., the National Institute of Standards and Technology and Rand Corporation.
courses.5mi0:
Students can harness the power of big data through statistical analysis and business acumen with Hult International Business School's one-year MBAN and go on to make a meaningful impact in any organization.

Students will develop the skills to become a data-driven business leader in a complex global environment. Students will dive into the world of data analysis, forecasting, prescription, and optimization while they work in parallel to hone their collaboration and communication skills as well as gaining critical business knowledge to maximize their impact. Students work in cross-cultural teams and gain a global perspective as they tackle real-world business challenges that are integrated into their entire program.
courses.5mi2:
Students will stand out in a competitive global marketplace with Hult International Business School's one-year Masters in International Marketing (MIM) that equips them with the international strategic skills, creative executional ability, and cutting-edge knowledge to thrive in a constantly shifting digital environment.

Students will understand the importance of the customer journey in today's fragmented media landscape. They will learn to develop a marketing strategy leveraging tools needed to market through digital channels, conduct market research with an eye toward new product development, and examine global market opportunities for expansion and growth. Students will gain a solid foundation of marketing analytic skills and learn to develop key metrics for a successful strategy as they take part in real-world business challenges that are integrated into their entire program.
courses.6d1o:
Husson University’s Master of Science in Occupational Therapy (MSOT) major is an engaging and career-oriented entry-level graduate degree program that prepares students for a fulfilling career in a quickly growing healthcare field.

Husson’s MSOT program takes seven semesters to complete (inclusive of fieldwork) and focuses on experiential learning in a wide range of clinical areas such as physical rehabilitation, mental health and pediatric practice. Students will learn how to help people of all ages maintain their independence and complete everyday tasks with a creative, problem-solving approach.

Once students graduate from Husson University with a Master of Science in Occupational Therapy, they’ll become eligible to take the National Board Certification in Occupational Therapy (NBCOT) exam. After successful completion of this exam, a student can become an Occupational Therapist Registered (OTR).

Husson’s OT degree programs are accredited by the Accreditation Council for Occupational Therapy Education (ACOTE) of the American Occupational Therapy Association (AOTA)
courses.68qn:
Students can take their career to new heights in this data-driven world with an affordable Master of Business Analytics program that combines leading-edge analytics and critical business skills. Together, with Iowa State University's internationally known faculty and hallmark fusion of theory and practice, students will discover how to obtain and manage data, apply analytical tools, and generate results-focused insights.

This Master's program provides a foundation in data analytics, project management, statistical and predictive modeling, consumer sentiment analysis, knowledge discovery, analytical reporting, segmentation analysis, and data visualization. The customized, capstone team project allows for focused training in areas such as fraud detection, risk management, text mining, and process improvement.
courses.6vgl:
The M.S. Computer Science degree programs stress both theoretical and experimental methods for solving fundamental as well as practical problems.

The highly regarded academics, groundbreaking research, and supportive environment makes Iowa State’s Department of Computer Science an exceptional place to pursue an advanced degree with immediate career applications.

Graduates are well-equipped to tackle some of the toughest problems companies present to them. Iowa State graduates go on to careers at the world’s leading companies such as Microsoft, Walt Disney, Google, Kingland, John Deere, LinkedIn, and many others.
courses.5iga:
The Data Science Master’s degree at the Johns Hopkins University will provide the training in applied mathematics, statistics and computer science to serve as the basis for an understanding, and appreciation, of existing data science tools. The program aims to produce the next generation of leaders in data science by emphasizing mastery of the skills needed to translate real-world data-driven problems in mathematical ones, and then solving these problems by using a diverse collection of scientific tools

The final Capstone Experience in Data Science (EN.553.806) is a research-oriented project which must be approved by the research supervisor, academic advisor and the Internal Oversight Committee. The Capstone Experience can be taken in multiple semesters, but the total number of credits required for successful completion is six (6). The goal of the final course and written paper is to allow the student to apply data analysis techniques learned in the program, and possibly to extend those ideas to more general settings or to new application areas. Lastly, the paper will be summarized in a poster session organized at the end of each semester.
courses.5igt:
The financial mathematics master’s program at Johns Hopkins is offered through the Department of Applied Mathematics and Statistics as a Master’s of Science in Engineering (MSE) degree. Students with a strong quantitative undergraduate background are encouraged to apply for admission to the program.

The Master’s program in Financial Mathematics will provide a solid foundation in applied mathematics, providing the basis for an understanding and appreciation of existing models commonly used in financial applications and inferential and computational tools for developing their solution. The program will also furnish the appropriate insights in Finance where quantitative skills are most germane. The combination of these elements will create a springboard for addressing today’s quantitative challenges in finance as well as provide the preparation to meet the challenges of the future.

Learning Objectives for Financial Mathematics Master’s students:

  • Gain knowledge of financial markets and asset classes, how markets are regulated, how they are structured and operate
  • Gain knowledge of investments, portfolios, asset allocation, risk management
  • Gain knowledge of how financial derivatives are modeled and valued
  • Gain an ability for areas of applied mathematics that are most useful in real financial application (statistical analysis, time series analysis, optimization, Monte-Carlo methods, stochastic processes)
  • Develop communications skills
  • Develop computational skills
  • Gain insight as to how this knowledge and these skills integrate in the workplace environment
courses.5ige:
The Master of Science in Engineering Management (MSEM) program at Johns Hopkins Whiting School of Engineering bridges the gap between technology and business by equipping students with the technical expertise and leadership skills they need to advance their career in the fast-paced world of technology.

The program offers a balanced number of engineering technical tracks and management courses, positioning students to innovate technically while building their professional acumen.

The Master of Science in Engineering Management (MSEM) degree program combines advanced course work in highly-specialized technical fields with a professional education in innovation, entrepreneurship, and management practices. Graduates of the program will be provided with the educational background to pursue professional management roles in industry.
courses.69f3:
The Addiction Counseling Master of Science degree program at Johnson & Wales University is designed to prepare graduates to serve the community as addiction counselors after 18 months of full-time study. The primary goal of the program is to prepare master's-level clinicians with the counseling skills that integrate theoretical foundations of professional counseling into positive client interaction and intervention skills.

The program emphasizes the development of attitudes, knowledge and skills essential in the formation of professional counselors who are committed to the ethical provision of quality services. In addition to the coursework required, students experience practicum and internship experiences under supervision of clinical professionals.

Students who are preparing to specialize as addiction counselors are expected to possess the knowledge and skills necessary to address a wide range of issues in the context of addiction counseling, treatment and prevention programs, as well as in a broader mental-health counseling context.
courses.69f4:
The Clinical Mental Health Counseling Master of Science degree program at Johnson & Wales University is designed to prepare graduates to serve the community as clinical mental health counselors after 18 months of full-time study. The primary goal of the program is to prepare master's-level clinicians with the counseling skills that integrate theoretical foundations of professional counseling into positive client interaction and intervention skills.

The program emphasizes the development of attitudes, knowledge and skills essential in the formation of professional counselors who are committed to the ethical provision of quality services. In addition to the coursework required, students experience practicum and internship experiences under supervision of clinical professionals.
courses.69f5:
The Cybersecurity Master of Science degree program builds cogently on the body of knowledge associated with the protection of networks, communication channels and information, and incorporates a set of core competencies in both technology and business as they relate to planning, implementing and managing system- and enterprise-level security.

This program is targeted for students who have bachelor’s degrees in information technology, computer science, and network and software engineering, as well as others who have earned bachelor’s degrees in fields outside these areas but need the graduate-level degree to advance professionally. All students must complete a capstone project.
courses.3u4:
The Master of Public Health in Public Health is designed to help students develop real-world knowledge and skills needed to pursue success in the public health industry.

The Epidemiology concentration prepares students to analyze the distribution and determinants of disease, disabilities and death in populations. Graduates are able to apply quantitative and qualitative methods to investigate disease outbreaks, determine causal relationships between environmental and biological factors, and conduct studies to project health trends in populations. Students benefit from public health faculty research agendas in bio-preparedness, public health surveillance systems, chronic disease, cancer and infectious disease epidemiology.

Career opportunities for graduates include research positions in universities, medical schools and pharmaceutical companies; disease prevention specialists in hospitals; and surveillance managers in state and local health departments.
courses.opb:
The Master of Science in Business Analytics provides students with a comprehensive knowledge of analytics that balances the technologies, analytical methods and business expertise needed to glean useful information from data to make strategic business decisions. The language of business today is dependent on information and data management, and the emergence of advanced technologies for capturing, preparing and analyzing data provides unprecedented opportunities for those with business analytics expertise that spans all industries and organizations.

Students in the Business Analytics major gain the technical, analytical, communication, decision-making and leadership skills needed to be successful business analysts.
courses.87mt:
Lewis University’s Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence (MSAI) degree is designed to provide students with an advanced education in one of today’s most high-demand fields: artificial intelligence (AI). It equips them with the skills necessary to contribute to the rapidly evolving AI landscape. Graduates will be capable of designing AI-based systems and leading AI-driven projects across various industries.

The Artificial Intelligence master’s degree program equips students with the in-depth knowledge and practical skills needed to build and implement modern AI systems. The program provides the necessary theoretical background in machine learning and artificial intelligence, knowledge related to the application of AI in computing systems, and an understanding of the ethical implications in the development and use of artificial intelligence. Graduates will be prepared for a wide range of careers where artificial intelligence is applied, including positions in industry or government, or for further graduate studies.
courses.6af7:
More and more organizations are looking for data-driven decision makers - those with a master’s degree in business analytics who have the educational qualifications to make strategic, operations, marketing and healthcare decisions based on objective and rock-solid data driven business intelligence.

Everyone is talking about “big data”. But there aren’t nearly enough qualified individuals ready to help organizations analyze and leverage data intelligence for improved decision making. This Master’s in Business Analytics from Lewis University will prepare students to do just that and enter one of the fastest-growing careers around.

Students will attain a working knowledge of how to use data intelligence tools for informed and objective decision making. Through an interdisciplinary curriculum they will:

  • Get real-world and hands-on experience with state-of-the-art data mining and business intelligence tools and technologies
  • Gain the quantitative and data analysis skills required to solve complex business problems
  • Learn how to develop corporate strategy by exploring relationships in an organization’s "big data" and predictive decision modeling.
  • Learn how to analyze large data sets to uncover hidden relationships and make more informed business decisions
  • Gain a working knowledge of data analysis techniques such as decision trees, classification, clustering, segmentation, decision support systems, search algorithms, data mining, factor and discriminant analysis and optimization concepts for data

Financial Analytics

Combining fundamental analytics theory with the abundant data available in financial markets, financial analysts can help solve quantitative problems ranging from maximizing stock price to determining optimal portfolios.
courses.6af8:
More and more organizations are looking for data-driven decision makers - those with a master’s degree in business analytics who have the educational qualifications to make strategic, operations, marketing and healthcare decisions based on objective and rock-solid data driven business intelligence.

Everyone is talking about “big data”. But there aren’t nearly enough qualified individuals ready to help organizations analyze and leverage data intelligence for improved decision making. This Master’s in Business Analytics from Lewis University will prepare students to do just that and enter one of the fastest-growing careers around.

Students will attain a working knowledge of how to use data intelligence tools for informed and objective decision making. Through an interdisciplinary curriculum they will:

  • Get real-world and hands-on experience with state-of-the-art data mining and business intelligence tools and technologies
  • Gain the quantitative and data analysis skills required to solve complex business problems
  • Learn how to develop corporate strategy by exploring relationships in an organization’s "big data" and predictive decision modeling.
  • Learn how to analyze large data sets to uncover hidden relationships and make more informed business decisions
  • Gain a working knowledge of data analysis techniques such as decision trees, classification, clustering, segmentation, decision support systems, search algorithms, data mining, factor and discriminant analysis and optimization concepts for data

Healthcare Analytics

The medical and diagnostic secrets hidden in the “big data” of patient outcome records are going to change the healthcare industry. Be a part of this massive and imminent shift toward improved patient health.
courses.4f9s:
The College of Management (COM) at Long Island University Post offers a new, 30-credit, specialized Master of Science in Data Analytics and Strategic Business Intelligence program (MDA) with a blend of data science, IT, and business courses to prepare students for the demand in industries for data-literate managers and data scientists with solid business knowledge and analytical skills.

The MDA program is designed for recent graduates or working professionals in their early or mid-career phases. The ideal student should have basic quantitative and IT knowledge and skills through prior coursework or working experience, and be highly motivated to learn how to deal with data as a strategic asset and apply IT and analytic methods to make data-driven business decisions.
courses.62la:
The M.S. in Biomedical Sciences will provide an advanced background for students who are interested in the medical field and who will ultimately apply for admission to medical, dental, veterinary, physician’s assistant or physical therapy professional programs as well as medical research. The core curriculum will provide a solid breadth of the basic medical sciences, with more focused study on specific topics such as global health, bioethics, and biotechnology. Students will have the opportunity to pursue an advanced research project with a faculty mentor.

The program aims to provide 3 core qualifications for its enrolled candidates:

  1. To improve the candidate’s knowledge about the basic biomedical sciences specifically in the fields of cellular biology, anatomy and physiology, microbiology, genetics, molecular biology, immunology, bioethics, biotechnology, and global health issues.
  2. To allow candidates to recognize the relationship between structure and function at all levels: molecular, cellular, organismal.
  3. To allow candidates to understand quantitative reasoning as it applies to skills in the biological sciences; to implement the scientific method in laboratory, classroom, and research projects; to become familiar with the use of equipment and instruments used in the biological sciences; adhere to laboratory safety guidelines; and finally learn valuable written and oral presentation skills.

Manhattanville's students are welcome to explore various disciplines within the biomedical sciences through coursework, teaching assistantships, and through their laboratory research program. Teaching assistantships and laboratory research experiences are overseen by a mentor to ensure students learn valuable skills and knowledge in these environments.
courses.62lm:
The Master of Science (MS) in Marketing Management degree program at Manhattanville University offers a robust framework in marketing and public relations principles and practices. Gain topical skills in market growth, innovation, social media, corporate communication, reputation management, and more.

Designed to enhance the capabilities of current marketing professionals, the marketing communication master’s degree program is 36 credits and available through evening and weekend classes, part-time.

Become a key driver of the growth of your business, whether it’s a large corporation, small business, nonprofit, or service organization. Our MS in Marketing Management leads to career advancement in the most dynamic and exciting business fields, from public relations and communications to marketing and business development.
courses.5t06: Marist’s MS in Computer Science - Software Development provides students with the hands-on resources and advanced technology to excel in the design, development, and implementation of software systems. Students will learn through state-of-the-art education during evening courses in either a part-time or full-time schedule. A STEM degree, the MSCS program utilizes exclusive tech partnerships with industry leaders such as IBM, and innovative on-ground technology, so students can graduate with the extensive software development experience employers are looking for.
courses.103x:
The M.S. in information technology and M.S. in cybersecurity dual-degree program is designed to meet the needs of students who desire a broad information technology background with a very strong cybersecurity emphasis. The dual degree will prepare students for cybersecurity technical and management positions where they are responsible for the security of a variety of technologies.

Upon successful completion of all dual-degree requirements, students will receive both an M.S. in information technology and an M.S. in cybersecurity. Students successfully completing both degrees will achieve the learning outcomes of each of these two programs.
courses.94gi:
The Master of Business Analytics at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology provides students with the specialized technical expertise needed to excel in the rapidly growing field of data science. This twelve-month advanced degree focuses on the practical application of analytical tools to solve complex organizational challenges, making it an ideal choice for recent graduates and high-tech professionals from engineering or mathematical backgrounds.

Students complete a rigorous three-semester curriculum that concludes with a mandatory seven-month capstone project. During this period, small teams collaborate directly with global organizations to address real-world data science problems, gaining hands-on professional experience through onsite company visits.

The degree culminates in a comprehensive written report and a formal presentation to industry leaders and expert faculty. This immersive approach ensures that graduates develop the necessary problem-solving and communication skills to lead data-driven initiatives in a variety of international business environments.
courses.94gg:
The Master of Engineering in Biomedical Engineering at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology offers a specialized five-year track that combines a bachelor degree in science or engineering with a professional master degree. This unique pathway integrates advanced engineering principles with modern molecular and genomic biology to prepare students for leadership in the biotech and medical sectors.

This program provides a seamless transition for MIT undergraduate students into graduate-level research and application. By focusing on the fusion of quantitative analysis and biological sciences, the degree ensures that graduates possess the technical credentials necessary to solve complex problems in human health and medicine.

Students from any department within the School of Engineering or School of Science are eligible to apply during their junior year. The application process identifies candidates with strong quantitative backgrounds and provides a clear timeline for completing both degrees within a five-year window. This streamlined approach allows participants to enter the workforce or advanced research roles with a competitive edge and high-level technical expertise.

Note: The Master of Engineering degrees are available to MIT undergraduates only.
courses.93tz:
The Master of Engineering in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology provides a streamlined five-year path to earning both a bachelor and master degree. This integrated experience allows students to dive deep into technical subjects while gaining practical skills through hands-on projects. Participants benefit from a flexible curriculum that adapts to their specific interests in the evolving tech landscape.

Students begin their journey by applying fundamentals to real-world systems such as robotics, mobile networks, and medical technology. As they progress, they take on advanced graduate subjects and fulfill a professional perspective requirement that prepares them for the global workforce. The degree emphasizes practical application, ensuring that graduates possess a sophisticated understanding of both hardware and software.

A central part of this degree is the completion of a high-level thesis, which can be conducted in a campus research lab or alongside an industry partner. Many participants start their research early during their undergraduate years, allowing for a smooth transition into graduate-level discovery. This comprehensive approach ensures that students leave with the expertise and professional connections necessary to lead in the technology sector.

Note: The Master of Engineering degrees are available to MIT undergraduates only.
courses.94g8:
The Master of Science in Aeronautics and Astronautics at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology provides a comprehensive two-year curriculum focused on advanced aerospace engineering and design. This degree combines graduate-level coursework with a research-based thesis to build high-level technical expertise. Students gain the foundational skills necessary to secure senior roles in the aerospace industry or to pursue further doctoral studies.

Participants engage in specialized subjects while conducting original research that contributes to the field of flight and space exploration. By working on a dedicated design or research project, students learn to apply theoretical concepts to complex engineering challenges. This hands-on approach ensures that every graduate is prepared for the practical demands of the modern aviation and space sectors.

This pathway at MIT connects students with world-class faculty and extensive departmental resources. The structured nature of the program allows individuals to develop a strong professional network while mastering the complexities of aerospace systems. Graduates emerge as capable leaders ready to drive innovation in global technology and engineering firms.
courses.94g9:
The Master of Science in Chemical Engineering Practice at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology provides a fast-track route to gaining high-level industrial experience. This degree allows students to complete their graduate studies in just one year following their bachelor's degree. It replaces the traditional research thesis with practical, real-world applications in professional settings.

Students spend two semesters engaged in advanced coursework on campus before heading to various industrial sites for a full semester of hands-on practice. These off-site placements are managed by resident staff, ensuring that the learning remains relevant to current industry standards. This structure enables participants to apply theoretical knowledge directly to complex engineering problems in the field.

By choosing this pathway at MIT, graduates gain access to world-renowned faculty and extensive institutional resources within the vibrant Greater Boston area. The program prepares students for immediate entry into the workforce by fostering professional leadership and technical expertise. This intensive experience offers a distinct advantage for those looking to accelerate their careers in the global chemical engineering sector.
courses.94gf:
The Master of Science in Materials Science and Engineering at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology offers a rigorous yet supportive environment where students collaborate on advanced research. This degree combines intensive lectures with hands-on laboratory work to prepare graduates for high-level technical positions. Participants gain the skills necessary to lead innovations that solve global challenges as scientists and educators.

Candidates enter a community known for intellectual enthusiasm and a strong sense of warmth. While this pathway focuses on deep technical mastery, it maintains a convivial atmosphere that encourages students to excel alongside world-class peers. The curriculum ensures that every graduate emerges ready to drive significant progress in the engineering field.

Prospective students typically pursue this research-based degree by connecting with specific faculty members to join dedicated research groups. This focused approach allows for a personalized education experience over one to two years of study. By aligning their interests with departmental expertise, students position themselves for leadership roles in professional and academic settings.
courses.94g7:
The Master of Science in Mechanical Engineering at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology focuses on the design, fundamental principles, and creation of advanced physical systems. This degree blends theoretical knowledge with hands-on learning to help students address significant global challenges through engineering. Participants develop the skills necessary to lead technical innovation while contributing to a better world.

Students within the Department of Mechanical Engineering engage in a curriculum that unites core engineering concepts with emerging scientific frontiers. This educational approach fosters an entrepreneurial spirit and encourages individuals to think creatively in both classrooms and laboratories. By pushing the boundaries of traditional design, the university trains future leaders to develop effective solutions for modern society.

This degree path offers a vibrant environment where discovery and practical application go hand in hand. Graduates emerge with the technical expertise and innovative mindset required to excel in competitive industries. Through cross-disciplinary learning and rigorous research, the program ensures that students are well-prepared to transform original ideas into impactful technologies.
courses.94gh:
The Master of Science in Nuclear Science and Engineering provides students with a comprehensive foundation in nuclear systems and prepares them for professional careers or advanced research. This degree emphasizes a strong technical grounding while allowing for specialized study tailored to specific career goals.

Participants have the opportunity to focus their expertise in areas such as nuclear fission technology, applied plasma physics, nuclear materials, nuclear security, or general nuclear science. The curriculum is flexible, enabling students to align their academic choices with their professional interests in the energy or technology sectors.

For those interested in the intersection of science and governance, there is an option to pursue a parallel degree in technology and policy. Students entering with a solid undergraduate background typically complete the graduation requirements within eighteen months of full-time study.
courses.94ga:
The Master of Science in Physics at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology focuses on researching matter and energy under extreme conditions to discover new scientific principles. Students investigate a vast range of topics, from the behavior of galaxies and elementary particles to the study of laser-cooled atoms and biological materials. This degree allows researchers to test advanced theories by pushing the boundaries of known physical laws.

A significant portion of this degree involves completing a master thesis based on independent research. Every student works under the direct supervision of a faculty member to ensure their project meets high academic standards. While the duration of study can vary based on the specific research project, most participants finish their requirements within approximately two years.

This pathway offers a flexible yet rigorous environment for those looking to advance their technical expertise. By engaging with complex problems like high-temperature superconductors and nuclear collisions, graduates develop the analytical skills needed for careers in science and technology. The department provides the resources and mentorship necessary for students to contribute meaningful findings to the global physics community.
courses.5tzh:
The Master of Science in Business Analytics prepares its graduates for employment in a high growth area of the economy. The program is offered to candidates who wish to enter or advance their careers in that field.

Business Analytics graduates are in high demand, as the business world is undergoing a data revolution. Most companies are now gathering data with the objective of driving business decisions, and there is an identified and pressing lack of skilled graduates at the intersection of business and data science.

At the end of this program, students should be able to:

  • Students will be able to utilize applicable statistical methods and tools to achieve specific outcomes using data
  • Students will be able to develop data-driven stories with the intent to: inform, educate or persuade through analysis and visual representation of data
  • Students will be able to critically think about the role of tools in analytics, current limitations and opportunities (and needs) for growth in data and analytics
  • Students will be able to identify ethical pitfalls faced in the utilization, manipulation, and management of data in an organization
  • Students will be able to form thoughtful arguments on the role of data, automation, technology and the human processes that achieve optimal balance in decision-making in business
  • Students will be able to give accurate descriptions and critical thoughts on how data flows within an organization and how it adds value to the organization
courses.5tt1:
Information systems and computer networks are under constant attack from hackers, viruses and worms. The Cybersecurity Master of Science degree prepares students with the technical and analytical skills to secure data files, defend computers, shield computer networks and protect critical national electronic infrastructure.

Students who graduate with a Master’s degree in Cybersecurity should be able to:

  • List the fundamental concepts of information assurance and cyber defense.
  • Identify the vulnerabilities in network infrastructures, and monitor the attack activities.
  • Describe proactive/reactive protocols, tools and techniques, apply the countermeasures.
  • Produce secure software components and perform software security analysis.
  • Describe cryptographic protocols, tools and techniques and apply crypto algorithms.
  • List applicability of laws and policies and describe the compliances and their impacts.
courses.4smv: The Master of Science in Computer Science is a broad-based degree offering students strong problem-solving, communication, and team skills to design, implement, and document computer software systems. The program is known for sending well-prepared students into a lucrative job market. Middle Tennessee State University graduates are valued by employers ranging from tech titans such as Google to area companies. Employment in the field is projected to grow at a rate of 15 percent through 2022, double the average rate of all occupations. Students, who choose from thesis and non-thesis options, are able to concentrate in specific areas or begin preparation for Doctor of Philosophy work. Master’s students also gain experience working with systems administration and helping create apps for the university. There are additional opportunities through professional organizations. Well-equipped computer labs are available extensive hours and also provide 24/7 remote software access. Video-conference attendance is possible in some classes. A limited number of graduate assistantships are available.
courses.4sr6: The Health Care Informatics master’s program at Middle Tennessee State University, a concentration in Professional Science, emphasizes the skills and experience that will prepare the next generation of professionals to be competitive in the business and healthcare information technology workforce. This interdisciplinary degree is well suited to traditional students as well as working professionals. The Master of Science in Professional Science is a groundbreaking master's degree in the sciences, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) disciplines that helps equip students for work in public and private business enterprises and in academia. Health Care Informatics is designed around concentration courses in information systems applications and security, project management, business intelligence/analytics, and healthcare law, and electives in valuable specialty areas like Six Sigma and Lean Productivity Systems. This concentration is supplemented by a core of business courses in accounting, statistics, managerial communication, leadership, and a capstone internship experience. The program has limited graduate assistantships awarded on a competitive basis.​
courses.5vxk:
Midwestern State University's (MSU Texas) McCoy College of Science, Mathematics and Engineering offers a Master of Arts in Biology (Biomedical Sciences emphasis).

The mission of the Master of Arts degree program in Biology is to help students enhance their understanding of the biological disciplines required for medical school or other professional health science programs. The program builds formal skills in analysis of biomedical literature and of ethical questions that impact the medical profession.

The Biology program at MSU Texas prepares students to become self-sufficient, independent thinkers who work heavily in scientific research. Often, graduates of the biology program put their skills to use in a variety of fields. The program is the optimal environment for learning. The faculty pride themselves on the 2:5 student-to-professor ratio that they are able to provide. This ratio results in the faculty being approachable and accessed more easily, and it allows professors to provide more one-on-one attention to students who are working on thesis research. The smaller enrollment size of the program means that the graduate and teaching assistantships are not as competitive as they may be at schools with larger enrollment numbers.
courses.5w1w: Midwestern State University's (MSU Texas) Master of Arts in History program offers courses in American, European, Latin American, British, Russian, and Middle Eastern history. The small class sizes allow faculty to work closely with students, often on a one-on-one basis, and to prepare students effectively in the discipline of history. Many graduates of the history program teach in public schools or at the collegiate level. Courses are designed to prepare students to meet the demands of a career in teaching or to pursue a doctoral degree. Students who choose not to teach go into fields such as journalism, museum work, library work, government work, or the business world. Additionally, a degree in history provides an excellent background for law school.
courses.61yx:
Midwestern State University's (MSU Texas) Master of Education in Curriculum and Instruction program at West College of Education is committed to faculty and student participation in scholarly discourse on all issues related to teaching and learning and to exploring the relationship between theory and practice in a variety of educational contexts.

The faculty value life-long learning, community, collaboration, diversity, inquiry, and reflection. Toward this end, they are committed to enhancing the ability of professional educators to meet the needs of a changing society by providing an innovative, logically organized program of educational experiences that are framed by a coherent core of research and foundational knowledge and that model exemplary teaching strategies grounded in inquiry and reflective practice. The faculty are also committed to active engagement in scholarship, service, and outreach while seeking opportunities to examine and integrate diverse educational perspectives through university, community, and statewide collaboration.

The Master of Education degree with a major in Curriculum and Instruction is designed to develop professional skills and knowledge. The graduate program requires 36 semester hours and is a non-thesis program. Eighteen hours of the degree program is comprised of coursework in the Curriculum and Instruction major; the remaining 18 hours of coursework is comprised of coursework from a minor of the candidate’s choosing that is based on their future professional goals.
courses.61z0:
The mission of Midwestern State University's (MSU Texas) Master of Health Administration program is to effectively prepare students to operate in leadership roles in the complex and changing environment of health services administration. MSU Texas strive to provide students with a cross-section of knowledge, skills, and abilities that prepare them to meet the health services administration needs of the larger community, as well as to assist them in accomplishing their career goals. Through ongoing faculty research and development, they aim to incorporate current theory and practice to provide an educational experience that effectively prepares students with diverse backgrounds and experiences to take on administrative roles within the health services delivery system.

Program Objectives:

  • Develop critical thinking and problem-solving skills to apply within a range of health services organizations
  • Develop leadership and human resource management skills to respond effectively in diverse health services settings
  • Apply core tools in the financial management of health services to support organizational success
  • Apply quantitative and qualitative analysis techniques to enable effective organizational decision-making and problem solving
  • Understand and apply health care ethics to issues that arise in the changing health services environment
  • Analyze and synthesize information for effective market-related and strategic decision-making and planning
  • Be knowledgeable about the regulatory and legal environment in which health services operate.
courses.6xxx:
The Computer Science department offers comprehensive Master of Science and Doctorate of Philosophy programs that focus on computer network security, software engineering, web databases, wireless systems, intelligent systems, data mining, parallel and distributed processing pervasive computing, computer networks, scientific visualization, and algorithms. These research activities support the department’s two major areas of excellence: software engineering and critical infrastructure protection.

The computer science department at Missouri Science and Technology makes use of both its own computer learning center (CLC) as well as university CLCs. The CLC contains a mix of Linux and Windows computing platform. Class sizes are kept small to facilitate student and faculty interactions. Research laboratories provide support for both undergraduate and graduate students.

Graduate student will do research alongside expert computer science faculty in the areas of distributed embedded systems, machine learning, data mining, and software engineering. Or they can choose the interdisciplinary route, doing research beside faculty in various engineering disciplines. In fact, they often work in large group settings with faculty from departments across campus, examining advanced research problems in bio-informatics, homeland security, embedded systems, and virtual reality. Cooperation between students and faculty at this advanced level is a hallmark of the computer science research program.
courses.6xy4:
Information technology continues to transform every aspect of the economy and society. The rapid spread of technology has generated the need for highly trained professionals to implement and maintain information systems to support business success. The Master of Science in Information Science and Technology will teach students how to design, develop and apply information systems in organizations and businesses.

Rapid spread of technology has generated the need for highly trained professionals to implement and maintain information systems. The program is designed to educate students in the design, development, and successful application of information systems in organizations.
courses.khw:
The Master’s of Public Health is a 45 credit program. Students are required to choose one of the following concentrations: Biostatistics and Epidemiology, Health Administration and Leadership, or Community Health. These concentrations are driven by a curriculum that provides extensive knowledge and skills needed to conduct essential public health services. The first semesters will involve traditional public health coursework, while the last semesters will be devoted to a practice-based internship and a thesis paper or integrative seminar focused on an outcome oriented project.

Biostatistics & Epidemiology

Biostatisticians and epidemiologists use statistical procedures, techniques, and methodologies to understand disease development and identify health trends, and recommend interventions or preventive programs. As a consequence, the policy or action can range from developing specific regulatory programs to general personal behavioral changes. Job titles include:

  • Research Project Manager
  • Surveillance Project Director
  • Research Assistant
  • Epidemiologist
  • Biostatistician
  • Data Management Specialist
courses.4ok:
The Master’s of Public Health is a 45 credit program. Students are required to choose one of the following concentrations: Biostatistics and Epidemiology, Health Administration and Leadership, or Community Health. These concentrations are driven by a curriculum that provides extensive knowledge and skills needed to conduct essential public health services. The first semesters will involve traditional public health coursework, while the last semesters will be devoted to a practice-based internship and a thesis paper or integrative seminar focused on an outcome oriented project.

Students can prepare to analyze public health needs in a community and develop programs to improve the population’s health. Community health work further involves investigation of the causes of poor health and disease, providing health education to affected communities, implementing programs to improve health and healthcare access, and advocating for public policy that supports community health. Some typical positions:

  • Health Education Specialist
  • Epidemiologist
  • HIV/AIDS Counselor
  • Director of Environmental Health
  • Nonprofit Coordinator
  • Public Health Nutritionist
  • Surveillance Project Director
courses.9ek2:
Modern public health issues require modern solutions. Greater access to public health datasets has increased the need for professionals who can analyze and interpret complex information.

The Master of Public Health (MPH) in Public Health Data Science from the King Graduate School combines public health knowledge with STEM expertise. This interdisciplinary program develops skills for addressing contemporary public health challenges. In addition to providing a foundation in traditional research methods, the curriculum explores how technology can be used to derive meaningful insights from complex data.

The MPH in Public Health Data Science prepares graduates to develop data-driven, evidence-based solutions to public health problems at the local, state, national, and global levels.

The program provides training across multiple scientific disciplines, supporting entry into several growing career fields.

According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), demand for epidemiologists and biostatisticians is expected to grow significantly faster than the average for all occupations over the next several years. Employment opportunities for data scientists are also projected to experience strong growth.

Graduates of the program may pursue stable and expanding career opportunities while contributing to public health initiatives in diverse communities locally and worldwide.
courses.4oj:
The Master’s of Public Health is a 45 credit program. Students are required to choose one of the following concentrations: Biostatistics and Epidemiology, Health Administration and Leadership, or Community Health. These concentrations are driven by a curriculum that provides extensive knowledge and skills needed to conduct essential public health services. The first semesters will involve traditional public health coursework, while the last semesters will be devoted to a practice-based internship and a thesis paper or integrative seminar focused on an outcome oriented project.

Students can explore solutions to public health issues at an administrative level so they can effect changes that benefit underserved and vulnerable populations through policy and legislative efforts. Some of the many job titles a public health graduate program prepares students for include:

  • Director of Public Health
  • Health Systems Analyst
  • Health Services Research Manager
  • Medical Officer
  • Program Manager
  • Director of Risk Management
  • Director of Patient Safety
  • Practice Manager
courses.16js:
The Master's of Science in Data Science degree at Montana State University is interdisciplinary program that draws on courses in three programs: Computer Science, Mathematics, and Statistics. The broad goal is to provide students with foundational training in data analysis, with equal emphasis on the principles of computer science, mathematics, and statistics, and the ability to apply these principles to a range of data-driven problems. More specifically, the learning outcomes for graduates of the program are:

  • Demonstrate knowledge of essential deterministic, randomized and approximation algorithms for data classification and clustering, dimensionality reduction, regression, and optimization.
  • Demonstrate knowledge in the principles and practice of statistical experimental design, statistical inference, and decision theory.
  • Demonstrate the ability to take a real-world data analysis problem, formulate a conceptual approach to the problem, match aspects of the problem to previously learned theoretical and methodological tools, break down the solution into a step-by-step approach, and implement a working solution in a modern software language.
  • Communicate data science problems, analyses, and solutions effectively to both specialists and non-specialists through the use of effective technical writing, presentations, and data visualizations, and teamwork and collaboration.
courses.16kc:
Program Description

Stimulating instruction and research are hallmarks of the Department of Physics at Montana State University which has been educating creative and productive scientists since 1964. The MSU physics program offers Master of Science and Doctor of Philosophy degrees. The physics faculty, with over 30 members, is committed to maintaining close contact with its more than 60 graduate students and postdoctoral scientists. As you read our literature, explore our web site, and talk to our students you will discover a faculty recognized worldwide for its research and teaching.

The Department of Physics grants the Master of Science Degree under two options: thesis option (plan A) or course work option (plan B). The thesis option requires course work in addition to a thesis defense. The requirement for a course work option is only course work. The course work Master’s is the Master’s degree that you receive en route to your Ph.D. You can find more information about the Master's program here.
courses.7uf: The Master of Science in Information Systems (MSIS) degree program is designed as a pragmatic, problem-solving oriented program that combines modern information technology practices with business practices. It examines the critical issues surrounding IT decision-making, the technological aspect of the solution, and the human aspect of the solution.
courses.6rte:
Master of Public Health

  • Course schedule works for working professionals
  • Opportunities for international or global internships
  • Option to pursue areas of interest such as urban, rural, migrant, or maternal child health
  • Experienced and public health credentialed faculty

Program is ideal for

  • People who aspire to help people and society — whether individually as an educator, on a larger scale as a manager or director shaping policies and services, as a researcher uncovering new understanding of public health, or in many other roles that influence public health.
  • Varied backgrounds welcome.
  • If students studied public health, this MPH program will further their skills and competencies.
  • If applicants are looking to transition into public health, no prior exposure or experience with public health is required. Students will gain exposure to the field, learn new skills, and gain hands-on experience. Students do need to complete the prerequisite coursework listed on the MPH apply page.
  • Public health especially complements nursing, legal studies, education, data analytics, community youth development, life/lab science, physical therapy, occupational therapy, communication sciences and disorders, sustainability, and ethical data science.
courses.5xig:
Computer science and business management are two popular graduate programs, and many people have a hard time choosing which one to study. The Business and Information Systems program allows students to study both. They will learn both computing science and business management, which will make them more marketable. Corporations are eager to hire students who have technical and managerial skills. Being well rounded will help them get promotions and, if they like, to become a manager.

Students will learn a wide range of leadership and management skills in addition to understanding and adapting to the rapid changes in the Information Technology field, such as analysis, design and programming, which have become "object-oriented," as Information Systems are impacted by concerns for privacy, ethics, intellectual property and compliance issues.
courses.5xio:
The objectives of the Master of Science - Cyber Security and Privacy program are:

  • Describe cybersecurity and privacy mechanisms, standards and state-of-the-art capabilities.
  • Describe potential cyber attacks and the actors that might perform them, and apply cyber defense methods to prepare a system to repel attacks.
  • Perform security review of applications, systems and infrastructure.
  • Design and implement system, network and infrastructure-level solutions to ensure the security and privacy of communications and data against specific security threats, while understanding the trade-offs between security, usability and performance.
  • Use standard security terminology to communicate effectively with other cybersecurity professionals.
  • Understand the ethical and legal implications of cyber attacks.
courses.5xip:
The Master of Science - Data Science - Computational program's objectives are:

  • Provide training in three core components of data science: machine learning, big data analysis and programming for Data Science.
  • Provide training in applied statistics, particularly statistical inference.
  • Cover applications and contemporary topics in Data Science.

Learning outcomes will allow students to:

  • Apply statistical methods for decision making.
  • Build and analyze predictive models from data using machine learning and statistical inference.
  • Program Data Science applications in high-level languages such as Python and R.
  • Analyze large datasets using high-performance computing and distributed computing methods.
  • Compare the benefits and drawbacks of contemporary and advanced topics in Data Science.
  • Make informed architectural decisions based on a good understanding of how available technologies differ and complement each other and what scalability and consistency trade-offs they provide.
courses.qis:
Program Description

Track I, 3-Years (90 credit-hours)

This track is for applicants who have an undergraduate bachelor's degree in disciplines other than architecture. Candidates to the 3-year track must earn 90 credit-hours and satisfactorily complete all required courses before a degree is granted.

NYIT’s Master of Architecture is centered on our innovative studio, technical, and liberal arts courses where students develop a critical understanding of the overlapping territories in which architecture is practiced: new technologies, materials, and building practices; culture, history, and politics; and their impacts on patterns of new and existing built forms. As technology and architectural practice evolve, this critical perspective enables NYIT graduates to offer design leadership that contributes to an increasingly sustainable built environment.

M.Arch candidates develop fluency with evolving technologies for effective problem solving, experimentation and communication, in an environment where specialists in related disciplines work with common purpose. Students will study with a faculty of distinguished scholars, professors of practice, and visiting faculty who bring unique focus and expertise.

NYIT’s M.Arch is a designated STEM program, making its international graduates eligible for the 24-month extension to the Optional Practical Training (OPT) visa.
courses.81cs:
The New York Tech Graphic Design and Media Innovation, M.F.A. is centered on the most up-to-date developments in the field, offering students the opportunity to create cutting-edge conceptual, aesthetic, and innovative visual projects.

Benefitting from a modern curriculum that reflects a shift in focus toward research and design for interactive applications, particularly in media, they will learn to apply emerging technologies to visual communication on several levels. In addition, they will build a solid foundation of essentials in the industry, from human-computer interaction and data analytics to the core thinking and innovation process.

They will develop deep expertise in the most current and relevant aspects of this evolving field, from participatory design to branding strategies to environmental graphic design. And, if they are interested in a career in academia, they will be able to pursue a college-level teaching position at the assistant professor rank due to the classification of the M.F.A. as a terminal degree.
courses.j1r:
Program Description

NYT’s 36-credit graduate program in urban design is located in the heart of midtown Manhattan, a world capital with world-class faculty, public-private organizations, and active professionals leading global practices.

This strategic campus setting enables students to combine theory with experience by living and working in a variety of urban areas and conducting field study in and around New York City. We’ll prepare students to succeed in the interdisciplinary field of urban design by providing opportunities for case studies to test and apply new insights, theory, and designs to contemporary and future challenges.

Students will learn to apply a range of design tools, including digital modeling for urban design, geographic information systems, urban micro-climate tools, and ecological performance indicators. Our program director is a leading researcher in urban climate science, and our Urban Climate Lab contributes to the critical dialog in New York City and other cities confronting climate change. Our popular study abroad program has been integrated into the design studio sequence, and our summer break prior to the third (final) semester encourages students to take on internships with New York-based firms or agencies.
courses.j3z:
Program Description

The Master of Science in Computer Science provides students with a comprehensive background in:

  • algorithms, computational theory, computer architecture, operating systems, compiler design and software based systems
  • theory and design of modern high-level programming languages and applications in development of systems software
  • design and analysis of efficient algorithms
  • advanced topics in computer architecture, illustrated by case studies from classic to modern processors, including large-scale computer systems
  • topics specific to chosen area of specialization, such as software engineering, computer security, networks, computer graphics, databases, information security, and artificial intelligence

The 30-credit curriculum also offers a thesis option in which students will take six credits relating to thesis courses. This allows students to gain specialization in areas that make them better qualified for specific research and development opportunities.

NYIT's Entrepreneurship and Technology Innovation Center in Old Westbury offers students the opportunity to join research projects in areas such as cybersecurity, health care, and energy. This may lead to their work getting published in peer-reviewed journals and presented at major conferences. Students can also join the annual Cybersecurity Conference at the school's Manhattan campus, attended by experts from academic, business, and government worldwide.
courses.4wa:
Program Description

The M.A. in Linguistics focuses on investigating language from both theoretical and functional approaches. Their dynamic curriculum combines core studies in the structure of language (phonology, morphology, syntax, semantics) with current approaches in sociolinguistics, language acquisition, psycholinguistics, language contact, world Englishes, endangered languages and language documentation, discourse analysis, and identity studies.

NEIU's carefully designed curriculum provides students with a solid foundation in the study and understanding of human language as a convergence of genetic, psychological and social systems and networks. We train students to critically examine and analyze the world within and around them—skills that can be applied to teaching, curriculum development, corporate cultures, legal contexts, intercultural communication, forensics, artificial intelligence, publishing, counseling, speech pathology, and child development. Knowledge of how and why we use language brings us closer to understanding who we are and how we can affect our worlds.
courses.7aqc:
The Doctor of Pharmacy/Masters in Public Health (PharmD/MPH) dual degree enables students to broaden the scope of their pharmacy training to include a public health perspective. Direct-Entry students can graduate with both a PharmD and MPH degree in just 5 years, saving one full year of study.

Students enrolled in the joint Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD)/Master of Public Health (MPH) Program have the opportunity to take graduate courses in the MPH Program while earning their PharmD.
courses.8jj5:
The Graduate Certificate in Blockchain and Smart Contract Engineering equips students with specialized knowledge in the rapidly evolving field of blockchain technology.

This program delves into blockchain platforms, such as Ethereum, that foster transparency and trust in complex multiparty relationships, impacting industries from finance to healthcare. Students will explore crypto-engineering techniques that establish digital trust, facilitating secure transactions.

Located in Arlington, VA, this program connects students with leading-edge companies and offers access to Northeastern’s extensive global network, setting them up for success in an expanding market.
courses.733t: The Master of Arts - Clinical Mental Health Counseling program prepares Students, through highly experiential classroom instruction in evidence-based counseling approaches, fieldwork experience, and internships, to become an applied counseling/psychotherapy practitioner to serve with clients of all ages in behavioral health agencies, clinics, hospitals and eventually private practices.
courses.ode:
The Computer scientists develop complex software and computer systems that are central to contemporary science, engineering, industry, and business. The program enables students to either enter the computer science workforce or continue on to a doctoral program of study.

Individual and team-based assignments will enable students to build mastery of important computer science skills and their practical applications in areas that include computer networks, computer graphics and visualization, high-performance computing, cybersecurity, machine learning, and data science, software engineering, software design and architecture, and software validation and verification. In addition, students will have the opportunity to engage in critical application areas of computer science in areas that include biology, ecology, and astronomy.

The non-thesis option of this program allows students to complete their degree through coursework and project-based learning, while the thesis option is focused on engagement with research projects under the mentorship of a faculty member and culminating in the preparation and defense of a thesis.

The program is strengthened through broad collaborations with a variety of other academic programs, government agencies, and private research organizations, including the departments of Biological Sciences and Physics and Astronomy, Center for Bioengineering Innovation, Pathogen and Microbiome Institute, Center for Ecosystem Science and Society, Merriam-Powell Center for Environmental Research, and United States Geological Survey.

The Computer Science degree program prepares graduates for careers in a wide variety of areas in the application of computer science to science, engineering, industry, and business. The thesis option of the program is particularly appropriate for preparing graduates to subsequently enter doctoral programs of study.

Common types of software applications include advanced simulations, data analysis using Big Data, search and data mining, cloud-based systems, user interfaces, mobile application development, computer graphics, and game development, high-performance parallel applications, and database design and applications.
courses.72mg:
Information Technology plays a critical role in daily life controlling most aspects of our digital communication, banking, social media, investments, research, and so much more. Information Technology governs the organization and setup of the infrastructure that computer networks rely on, the database warehousing systems that enable access to data, the cybersecurity processes that are needed to ensure the safety of University information and systems, and the programming that is necessary to put their modern systems of knowledge together quickly and effectively.

The Master of Science in Information Technology program will enable students to build mastery in information technology, cybersecurity, programming, and database design and management. Graduates will be prepared to contribute to a wide variety of Information Technology areas in both academia and professional practice.
courses.34j:
The Master of Science Statistics form the backbone of a multitude of research endeavors and is essential in the design of experiments and analysis of experimental data—in disciplines old, new, and cutting edge. This non-thesis advanced degree concludes with a comprehensive exam conducted by the student's advisory committee.

Statistics is a profession in its own right, but it's also an essential tool in countless career fields; from physical and social science to business, engineering, and marketing. Government and industry employers need skilled statisticians for operations research, numerical analysis, simulation and modeling, data analysis, market research, and commercial surveys. In the Master's Degree in Statistics, students will receive rigorous training in the design of experiments and the analysis and interpretation of results.
courses.611l:
Nova Southeastern University curriculum is designed to help students with hiring, managing, and retaining talent; optimizing operations; growing a client base; marketing; technology acquisition and implementation; controlling cost; and improving quality. The university's faculty members will tap into their thorough experience outside the classroom to ensure that students' learning experiences are practical, useful, and powerful.
